scopeResolution.note: checkCandidate in src/application/authorization-evaluator.mjs now branches on exact enumerable key-set shape: the legacy three-key {policyId, effect, applies} shape and the v2 five-key {policyId, effect, applies, priority, layer} shape are both checked via the existing hasExactEnumerableDataKeys descriptor guard (refusing accessor-defined, non-enumerable, extra-key, proxy-wrapped and class-instance forms identically to before); any other shape is refused. A legacy candidate is normalized internally to {priority: 0, layer: 'tenant'} without mutating the caller's object and without adding priority/layer to the public PolicyDecision. priority is validated with Number.isSafeInteger; layer is validated against an exact system|platform|tenant set. Duplicate policyId is still refused across shapes via the existing seen-set. The prior smallestPolicyId tie-break was replaced by winningPolicyId, a single linear scan comparing priority (desc), then a fixed layer-rank table system=2>platform=1>tenant=0 (desc), then policyId (asc); applied identically to the applicable-deny group and the applicable-allow group, so deny-overrides stays absolute and unaffected by priority/layer.
